posts.post: This is the first post in our social feed application. It demonstrates the database-driven architecture where all data is stored in XML and automatically persists across sessions.
With the new architecture, all mutations (likes, comments, posts) are persisted immediately to the database. No more transient object conversions!

comments.comment: Great work on this architecture! Much cleaner than before.
I love how the forms are generated from .orion files. Very declarative!
The combobox foreign key binding works perfectly for author selection.
